title: Graph_Export node CSV header rules (Neptune-loader / neo4j-admin superset)
description: Gzipped CSV. Reserved columns first, then sorted property columns.
rules: Column 0 MUST be ~id (the stable node id).
Column 1 MUST be ~label (the node label, tenant-prefix preserved verbatim).
Remaining columns are property names sorted lexicographically.
Complex property values are JSON-encoded; null/absent values are empty strings.
The same file loads under neo4j-admin import (which reads :ID/:LABEL); the Neptune ~id/~label form is the superset written here.
